description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the CountryService in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing various methods related to country and province data retrieval and manipulation.

classes.name: CountryServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of the CountryService class in the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case and creates a new instance of CountryService.

methods.name: testGetCountryDao
methods.description: Tests the getter and setter for the CountryDao in the service.

methods.name: testSetCountryDao
methods.description: Confirms the ability to set and retrieve the CountryDao.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of countries from the service.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of provinces from the service.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a country by its name.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Tests retrieving a country by its code.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests retrieving a province by its code.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Tests converting a list of country objects into an array suitable for dropdowns or UI elements.
